topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture’s aims and places cancer evolution within the preceding Cancer Biology lectures.

topics.label: Cellular changes driving clonal evolution and transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how changes within cells create the potential for clonal expansion and malignant transformation.

topics.label: Stemness, tumor hierarchy and the cell of origin
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how a cell’s position in a differentiation hierarchy affects its capacity to initiate or propagate cancer.

topics.label: Microenvironmental support for tumor initiation and growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics show how signals from surrounding cells provide conditions that enable mutant cells to develop into tumors and sustain malignant growth.

topics.label: Investigating cancer evolution with single-cell and spatial omics
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how molecular profiling of human tissue can reveal tumor evolution and interactions between cells.

topics.label: Converging conditions for malignant evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates the conditions required for malignant evolution and extends their implications to developmental timing and changing cellular states.

topics.label: Lecture close and next lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic ends the lecture and announces the forthcoming discussion of cancer therapy.
